# InterviewLab

> InterviewLab is an AI-powered interview-preparation platform for systems engineers, site reliability engineers, and software architects. It uses a resume and optional job description to create targeted practice interviews, evaluate responses, and surface coaching insights.

InterviewLab supports resume-based interview preparation, tailored technical and behavioral questions, response evaluation, interview history, learning-progress tracking, and account settings. Users provide their own supported LLM-provider API key to generate interview content.

Authentication is required for product data and interview functionality. Do not include API keys, credentials, resumes, or other personal data in prompts or public documentation.

## Product

- [InterviewLab application](/): Use the web application to sign in, configure an API key, upload a resume, and begin a practice interview.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): View interview-preparation activity and start a new session.
- [New interview](/new-interview): Create a tailored interview from a resume, an optional job description, and selected difficulty settings.
- [Interview history](/interview-history): Review completed practice sessions and their evaluations.
- [Resume library](/resumes): Manage resumes available for future interview sessions.
- [Learning progress](/learning-progress): Review skill-level progress derived from completed interviews.
- [Settings](/settings): Manage profile, appearance, connected LLM-provider API keys, and account security.

## Technical documentation

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Devanshukoli/InterviewLab/main/README.md): Architecture, local setup, configuration, and operational guidance for InterviewLab.
- [Database documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Devanshukoli/InterviewLab/main/sql/README.md): Supabase schema and migration instructions.
